latest_release.body:
## Fixes
* Fixed issue with release widget when specifying repositories with `include-prereleases` (thanks @kevin9327)
* Fixed the search widget preventing shortcuts including the `S` key from working (thanks @idpfaff)
* Fixed markets chart rendering when all history values are 0 (thanks @HocVoNgThai)
* Fixed the "SHOW MORE" arrow icon when using custom fonts (thanks @hafizahmedzia)
* Fixed the URL which opens when clicking on entries in the change detection widget (thanks @drshajul)
* Fixed IPv6 addresses in `sock-path` not working for the `docker-containers` widget (thanks @cuishuang)
* Fixed docker container children getting filtered when no category is specified (thanks @ethanstoner)

## Fixed vulnerabilities

A number of vulnerabilities have been fixed in this release, thanks to the following contributors:

- @Partha-dev01
- @akash111-hue
- @kishi78
- @AARUSHGAUR
- @Fluxmux
- @senti-man

detail.readme_excerpt:
Glance

Install • Configuration • Discord • Sponsor

Community widgets • Preconfigured pages • Themes

A lightweight, highly customizable dashboard that displays
your feeds in a beautiful, streamlined interface

![](docs/images/readme-main-image.png) ## Features ### Various widgets * RSS feeds * Subreddit posts * Hacker News posts * Weather forecasts * YouTube channel uploads * Twitch channels * Market prices * Docker containers status * Server stats * Custom widgets * [and many more...](docs/configuration.md#configuring-glance) ### Fast and lightweight * Low memory usage * Few dependencies * Minimal vanilla JS * Single <20mb binary available for multiple OSs & architectures and just as small Docker container * Uncached pages usually load within ~1s (depending on internet speed and number of widgets) ### Tons of customizability * Different layouts * As many pages/tabs as you need * Numerous configuration options for each widget * Multiple styles for some widgets * Custom CSS ### Optimized for mobile devices Because you'll want to take it with you on the go. ![](docs/images/mobile-preview.png) ### Themeable Easily create your own theme by tweaking a few numbers or choose from one of the [already available themes](docs/themes.md). ![](docs/images/themes-example.png)
## Configuration Configuration is done through YAML files, to learn more about how the layout works, how to add more pages and how to configure widgets, visit the [configuration documentation](docs/configuration.md#configuring-glance).
Preview example configuration file
```yaml pages: - name: Home columns: - size: small widgets: - type: calendar first-day-of-week: monday - type: rss limit: 10 collapse-after: 3 cache: 12h feeds: - url: https://selfh.st/rss/ title: selfh.st limit: 4 - url: https://ciechanow.ski/atom.xml - url: https://www.joshwcomeau.com/rss.xml title: Josh Comeau - url: https://samwho.dev/rss.xml - url: https://ishadeed.com/feed.xml title: Ahmad Shadeed - type: twitch-channels channels: - theprimeagen - j_blow - piratesoftware - cohhcarnage - christitustech - EJ_SA - size: full widgets:
